# Code of conduct

This project is a small, friendly reference for WordPress developers. Everyone is welcome here, whatever their experience level.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and assume good intent.
- Keep feedback about the work, not the person.
- Be patient with questions, including ones that seem basic.
- Accept corrections gracefully; being wrong about WP_Query happens to everyone.

## Not acceptable

- Harassment, insults or personal attacks.
- Discriminatory jokes or language.
- Publishing someone's private information without permission.
- Spam or repeated off-topic posting.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit or remove comments, issues and pull requests, and block people from the repository, when this code is not followed. To report a problem privately, contact the maintainer through the [CC Software GitHub organization](https://github.com/ClearanceClarence-Software).
